Możliwe, że są one pochodną kontaktów między Jutlandią a obszarem kręgu nadłabskiego. Mała fibula swastykowa może być lokalnie wytworzoną fibulą, mimo że zapinki te są typowe dla obszarów prowincjonalnorzymskich. Prostokątne fibule tarczowate z Vorbasse należy uznać za lokalny typ fibuli, który jest charakterystyczny dla centralnej i południowej Jutlandii i datowany na okres C2. Fibule pierścieniowe w Danii i na innych obszarach germańskich były prawdopodobnie inspirowane rzymskimi fibulami pierścieniowymi, które były powszechne już we wczesnych rzymskich obozach warownych wzdłuż Renu i Dunaju. Bliski kontakt między Germanami a północnymi prowincjami rzymskimi prawdopodobnie przyczynił się do rozpowszechnienia tej formy fibuli wśród ludów germańskich już od wczesnego okresu rzymskiego B2. Nie wyklucza to, że niektóre z germańskich fibul pierścieniowych mogły być wytworzone w prowincjonalnorzymskich warsztatach. Dwie fibule pierścieniowe z grobu VBII.22 można datować na okres C2, co czyni je jednymi z najpóźniejszych fibul pierścieniowych znanych z Danii.

This chapter discusses the disc-shaped and ring-shaped brooches found at the Vorbasse cemetery. The circular disc brooch with a flat covering and the bird-shaped disc brooch are likely local variants of circular and zoomorphic disc brooches. Their presence in Jutland may be the result of influences from the Elbe region.  The small swastika brooch may have been locally produced, even though such brooches are typical of the provincial Roman areas. 
The rectangular disc brooches from Vorbasse should be considered a local type of brooch, characteristic of central and southern Jutland, and dated to the C2 period.

Ring brooches in Denmark and other Germanic areas were likely inspired by Roman ring brooches, which were already common in the early Roman forts along the Rhine and Danube. The close contact between the Germanic peoples and the northern Roman provinces probably contributed to the spread of this type of brooch among the Germanic peoples as early as the Roman Iron Age B2. This does not exclude the possibility that some Germanic ring brooches were produced in provincial Roman workshops. The two ring brooches from grave VBII.22 can be dated to the C2 period, making them some of the latest-known ring brooches from Denmark.

The rise of Indo-Pacific as geopolitical construct and axis of the US-China global rivalry, raises questions about the role of strategically located Pakistan in the newly evolving international system. In Pakistan’s political nomenclature, the specific reference to the Indo-Pacific, regarded as part of the American narrative, is practically non-existing; Pakistan refers instead to Asia Pacific, with regard to the Arabian Sea in the northern Indian Ocean, as one of the key pillars of its security strategy. This policy is a combined effect of the state’s geographical location, its ideologically based inception followed by a protracted antagonism with India, and the contemporary challenges of the evolving regional security architecture. The unquestionably pivotal role of militarily and economically dominant India in Pakistan’s perception of existential threats, motivates its authorities to develop geostrategic potential; the naval build-up provides an exemplification of these efforts. This chapter seeks to investigate the selected aspects of interpretation and materialization of Pakistan’s regional security policy. Historically grounded, multi-dimensional relations with China, persistent urge to cooperate with powerful patron-state and attractive investments from the Pakistani stakeholders’ point of view within the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor as well as Chinese military support to protect the infrastructure, make Pakistan one of China’s most trusted allies. The main hypothesis is based on the assumption that international dynamics in the Indo-Pacific, as well as the gradual weakening of the US-Pakistani alliance and Pakistan’s permanent confrontation with historically inherited and current security dilemmas, suggest that this South Asian nuclear actor will construct its Indo-Pacific strategy primarily by deepening cooperation with China, thus becoming a key regional acolyte of Chinese expansion.

Among the 184 officially registered religious minorities, which include 2.2 per cent of the Polish population, only eleven represent East Asian religions, and two others are officially registered associations. Drawing on the limited statistics, we can estimate that they include circa 1300-1500 members. The most numerous groups among East Asian religiosities in Poland are those representing Zen Buddhism - there are eight registered religious denominations in this category. Apart from these there are also the Unification Church, the Meditation Association of the Supreme Master Czing Hai in Poland, the Taoist Union Tao Te King, and Falun Gong (the latter is a registered association). The chapter presents the history and activities of East Asian religiosities in Poland, discusses academic research and literature on the subject, and shows the challenges and fields of research that need to be explored.

Each subsequent generation is a new challenge for public, social life and the economy. This is related to evolutionary socio-cultural changes that affect almost every sphere of life. Currently, representatives of Generation Z are entering public, social and economic life, and their information expectations may be much higher than those of their predecessors. This may be due to the fact that they were born and raised in the era of common access to the Internet. This creates challenges, among others, in the areas of healthcare and education. Therefore, the main goal of the presented article is to determine the expectations of Generation Z in terms of health information, and then, on this basis, to identify the opportunities and challenges related to it, which is particularly important from the perspective of health policy makers, medical doctors and managers of medical organizations. Therefore, an original research form was designed and distributed electronically among representatives of Generation Z at one of the universities in Poland. The research results actually confirm the quite high information expectations of respondents regarding broadly understood health.

The paramount objective of International Humanitarian Law (IHL) is to limit the use of armed force through measures such as the protection of individuals who are not participating in hostilities or who have ceased to participate directly in combat. This law further prohibits the use of excessive and unjustified violence against the enemy, which results in unnecessary suffering. Consequently, IHL subjects the actions of warring parties to humanitarian imperatives, placing the intrinsic value of human life above all. This humanitarian principle, however, would not be achievable if the law operated on the principle of reciprocity, as seen in general international law. In the context of humanitarian law, each party to the conflict - whether a state or a non-state armed group - is responsible for its own obligations and must uphold them regardless of whether the opponent complies with or violates IHL. Compliance with IHL must also remain unaffected by the cause that led a state to use force - all parties to an armed conflict hold the same rights and obligations, irrespective of the justness of their cause, even when one party's use of force contravenes international or domestic law. This unique approach to humanity within IHL thus necessitates special rules characterized by objectivity, which define the distinctive nature of this law: the obligations arising from it must be observed independently of the opposing party's conduct and regardless of the reason behind the outbreak of armed conflict.

The background to my reflections developed in this article is the controversial legal philosophy of Scott Veitch, which challenges conventional thinking about law and its institutions. In his first book Moral Conflict and Legal Reasoning, Veitch confronts liberal legalism with Isaiah Berlin’s pluralistic perspective in ethics and concludes that it is not possible to reconcile the two positions. In his later work, Law and Irresponsibility, Veitch argues that legal institutions are often used as a means of organised irresponsibility. Starting with a reconstruction of Veitch’s iconoclastic theses, I then move on to present two situational contexts that occurred in Poland and that have direct relevance to the issue of euthanasia. The two states of affairs are strikingly different, although in both cases the indication for euthanasia comes into play. I then confront both of these situational contexts with two distinct moral keys identified within feminism – an ethic of justice and an ethic of care. I show that each of the distinct cases described aligns with different moral keys. This is a strong argument for adopting a pluralist perspective in ethics, which, however, does not go in pair with liberal legalism. It is for this reason that Ronald Dworkin’s position, as an embodiment of ethical monism, liberal legalism and an ethic of justice, may prove particularly damaging in its effects. And it is one that can teach lawyers an invaluable lesson in humility.

Dane antropologiczne wskazują na rolę, jaką odgrywały typowo męskie formy mobilności, takie jak wyprawy handlowe czy kampanie wojskowe, w rozpowszechnianiu elementów kultury materialnej, które były przypisywane mężczyznom. W przeciwieństwie do mobilności na długie dystanse, będącej aspektem niektórych aktywności męskiej części przednowoczesnych populacji, role społeczne związane z kobietami ograniczały średni dystans ich przemieszczeń. W pewnym stopniu to zjawisko można również dostrzec w zapisie archeologicznym. Analiza wzorców rozmieszczenia elementów stroju kobiecego i męskiego może ujawnić, jak daleko przemieszczały się kobiety i mężczyźni. Im dalej przemieszcza się jednostka, tym większy kontrast między obcymi a lokalnymi dobrami. Zapinki A.VI z zestawów grobowych w Vorbasse I - III wskazują, że osoby noszące te zapinki nawiązywały wielokierunkowe i dalekosiężne kontakty. Niektóre z zapinek wskazują na krąg nadłabski (prawdopodobnie wschodnie Holsztyn, ale możliwe są również bardziej odległe obszary), inne zaś na Bornholm lub obszar kultury wielbarskiej. Dokładny charakter tych kontaktów jest trudna do ustalenia. Kwestia ta powinna być omawiana w kontekście bardziej ogólnych rozważań na temat mobilności jednostek w III i pierwszej połowie IV wieku n.e. – okresu równie "aktywnego" jak czas wielkich migracji w V wieku. Tę mobilność można prawdopodobnie, przynajmniej częściowo, powiązać z udziałem różnych grup barbarzyńskich wojowników w konfliktach wewnątrz i poza granicami Cesarstwa Rzymskiego. Ta kwestia jednak oczywiście wymaga bardziej szczegółowych i złożonych badań.

The chapter is a presentation of simple brooch forms from Vorbasse cemetery. It can be concluded that A.VII-brooches representing different variants of types MP.IIIA and IIIB can be considered to be local products, most likely manufactured somewhere in Jutland or at least on the Jutland Peninsula. They occur in both male and female graves. In terms of the brooches of group A.VI from Vorbasse, the situation is different. All of them represent forms, which are foreign to Jutland. The majority were found in male graves. This may be explained by anthropological and historical parallels concerning the character and range of migration of the male part of pre-modern societies. Anthropological data points to the role that has been played by typically male forms of mobility, such as trade expeditions or military campaigns, in spreading those elements of material culture which had male attribution. In contrast to the long-range mobility being an aspect of some activities of the male part of pre-modern populations, the social roles associated with women limited the average distance of female.  To some degree, this phenomenon can be seen in the archaeological record, too. An analysis of the distribution patterns of female and male dress elements may reveal how far women and men moved. The further away an individual moves, the bigger the contrast gets between foreign and local goods. The A.VI-brooches from the burial assemblages at Vorbasse I - III indicate that the individuals who wore these brooches engaged in multidirectional contacts over long distances. Some of the brooches point out towards the Elbian circle (possibly eastern Holstein, but more distant areas are also possible) and other towards Bornholm or the area of the Wielbark culture. The exact nature of these contacts is more difficult to determine, though. This issue should be discussed in the light of more general considerations concerning the mobility of individuals in the 3rd and the first half of the 4th centuries AD – a period equally "active" as the period of the great migrations in the 5th century. This mobility can probably, at least to some extent, be linked with events of a military character in which various groups of barbarian warriors, whether or not they are mentioned in ancient written sources, were involved in conflicts within and outside the borders of the Roman Empire. However, this issue obviously requires more detailed and complex studies.

Jewish studies are characterized by their interdisciplinarity, and the history of education is explored not only by historians but also by educators seeking historical antecedents to contemporary educational challenges. In this article, I identify these trends and illustrate, using research on Galicia as an example, how a broader inclusion of Jewish and Judaic studies can transform the approach to studying education. Additionally, as recent studies on the history of

Technicyzacja życia przynosi wiele korzyści, ale jednocześnie wyzwala w ludziach niszczycielskie procesy, nierzadko także nieuświadomioną autodestrukcję. W konsekwencji następuje regres cech, zachowań ludzkich. Wraz z rozwojem technologicznym w niepomierną siłę urosła informacja, która stanowi wyróżnik współczesnych czasów. Jest czynnikiem sprawczym a nade wszystko sterującym. Celem artykułu jest podjęcie refleksji na temat funkcjonowania jednostki w społeczeństwie informacyjnym w kontekście recepcji informacji oraz roli zarządzania. Opracowanie ma charakter teoretyczny, zatem od strony metodyki celem prowadzonych rozważań było wzbogacenie istniejącej wiedzy i wytworzenie nowej w oparciu o metodę analizy oraz syntezy dostępnej literatury przedmiotu. Ograniczeniami dokonanych analiz jest forma publikacji oraz teoretyczność pracy. W związku z powyższym należałoby poszerzyć, zgłębić i dopracować problematykę w warstwie teoretycznej oraz poddać ją weryfikacji empirycznej. Rozwiązania technologii cyfrowej czynią ludzi zależnymi i ufnymi wobec nich. Poprzez to niejednokrotnie „automatyzujemy” swoje myślenie i zachowania, także w odniesieniu do przyjmowanych informacji. Unikamy w ten sposób wysiłku poznawczego i nierzadko prawda ustępuje miejsca ułudzie rzeczywistości, co w rezultacie przekłada się negatywnie na stosunki międzyludzkie, szerzej – tworzenie iluzorycznego, alternatywnego świata. Wartość poznawcza artykułu sprowadza się do podjęcia próby konceptualizacji zarządzania recepcją informacji w odniesieniu do wyróżnionych modeli mentalno-behawioralnych.

We live in a highly technological society. The technologicalization of life brings benefits and at the same time triggers destructive processes in people, often also unconscious self-destruction. As a consequence, there is a regression of human characteristics and behavior. With technological development, information has grown in immeasurable power, which is the hallmark of modern times. It is a causative factor and, above all, a controlling factor. The article aims to reflect on the functioning of an individual in the information society in the context of the reception of information and the role of management. This study is theoretical, therefore, from the methodology perspective, the considerations aimed to enrich the existing knowledge and create new knowledge based on the method of analysis and synthesis of available literature on the subject. The limitations of the analyses performed are the publication’s form and its theoretical nature. Therefore, it would be necessary to broaden, deepen, and refine the theoretical issues and subject them to empirical verification. Digital technology solutions make people dependent on and trusting of them. Thanks to this, we often “automate” our thinking and behavior also about the information we receive. In this way, we avoid cognitive effort, and often the truth gives way to the illusion of reality, which in turn hurts interpersonal relationships, and more broadly—the creation of an illusory, alternative world. The cognitive value of the work comes down to an attempt to conceptualize the management of information reception about the distinguished mental-behavioral models.

abstracts.content: The virtue of mildness, which is the subject of this essay, takes several somewhat different forms, although these are linked by a clear "family resemblance". They are similar in the sense that they constitute a specific form of what is generally understood as kindness and understanding. The first of these forms is mildness as a strictly political or public virtue (clementia in Seneca’s classical treatise with that title), which can refer to punishments imposed by a judge, a criminal legal system in its entirety (here it is not so much a virtues as a feature of that system), and to a manner of exercising authority in a political system of "domination" (in which there is, thus, a lack of individual, or more precisely, republican freedom). The second form is mildness as a private virtue, which is thoroughly examined by Norberto Bobbio in his essay "Elogio della mitezza" (In Praise of Meekness), in which he argues that there is no place for it in political life. While agreeing with Bobbio that the primary field of "operation" of this second form of mildness is the private sphere, one can justifiably maintain that it may become a desirable feature in a politician, if only the understanding of politics is given a somewhat more elevated meaning. In this article the conceptual relations between the two forms of mildness are also analyzed.

The author of this paper interprets two texts from contemporary Slovak literature - Silvester Lavrík’s  novel Nedeľné šachy s  Tisom (Sunday

in the context of Tzvetan Todorov’s concept of exemplary memory. This
concept assumes the possibility of using historical knowledge, especially
about the tragic and traumatic aspects of history to counteract, based on
similar mechanisms, the negative phenomena of the present, whose manifestations are nationalistic tendencies, discrimination against specific
social groups, and stigmatisation practices. Lavrík’s novel is thematically

while Vadas’s prose recalls the anti-Roma pogrom of 1928, which has

the position of bystanders, and about individual responsibility.

Początki steinologii polskiej sensu largo w latach 1924 i 1933 zostały opisane bardziej szczegółowo, zaś etap wojny oraz lata 50. i 60. - syntetycznie. Za przełomowy uznany został rok 1968, początkujący trzy nowe nurty recepcji Edyty Stein w polskich kręgach naukowych, wyznaczone przez postaci Romana Ingardena, Karola Wojtyły i Janiny Adamskiej. Aby uwydatnić zakres i wysoki poziom współczesnej steinologii polskiej, także tej uprawianej w świętującym 20-lecie działalności Centrum Badań im. The text analyses selected stages in the development of Polish scholarly reflection on Edith Stein and proposes a definition of Steinology sensu largo and Steinology sensu stricto. The beginnings of Polish Steinology sensu largo in 1924 and 1933 are described in detail, while the war period and the 1950s and 1960s are summarised. The breakthrough year of 1968 is seen as the beginning of three new currents in the reception of Edith Stein in Polish academic circles, marked by the activities of Roman Ingarden, Karol Wojtyła and Janina Adamska. In order to highlight the scope and high level of contemporary Polish Steinology, including that of the Edith Stein Research Centre in Poznan, it is described in contrast to the early stages of Polish scholarly reflection on Edith Stein and in relation to selected international Steinological achievements.

The New Southbound Policy (NSP), implemented in Taiwan since 2016 under the leadership of President Tsai Ing-wen, could be understood as a strategy to influence its neighboring countries from South and Southeast Asia to Australia and New Zealand. The development of such a targeted cooperation is in line with the regional strategy of the allies, especially the United States, in the Indo-Pacific region. The aim of the paper is to verify the assumptions and current results of the NSP between 2016 and 2020 in the area of economic cooperation: foreign trade and investment. The study answers the question of the effectiveness of the decisions made by the authorities to shift the importance of economic cooperation with China to the South. The study shows that even though the authorities give priority to the NSP, its implementation has so far failed to make a significant difference in Taiwan’s strength. Analysis of the directions, level of trade and direct investment of Taiwan with the countries of the NSP group highlighted the difficulties in reducing dependence on the Chinese market.

abstracts.content: Dla trzech tytułowych filozofów problematyka czasu byłą z różnych powodów niezwykle ważna. Brentano w swej psychologii opisowej zmagał się z trudnością pogodzenia prezentacji przedmiotów czasowo rozciągłych z metafizycznym założeniem momentalnego charakteru teraźniejszości. Husserl odrzucił to założenie i potraktował prezentację przedmiotów czasowo rozciągłych jako autentyczną percepcję. Heidegger wreszcie potraktował czasowość jako podstawową strukturę Dasein rozumianego jako projekt.

Three mentioned in the title philosophers for various reasons found the philosophical analysis of time crucial. Brentano in his descriptive psychology tried to reconcile the metaphysical thesis assuming momentary character of the present with the undeniable phenomenon of presentation of temporally extended objects. Husserl rejected this assumption and interpreted presentation of temporally extended objects as a genuine perception. And Heidegger finally started to construe temporality as a basic structure of Dasein, understood as a projection.

abstracts.content: Cmentarzyska w Vorbasse zawierały kilka kobiecych pochówków wyróżniających się bogactwem elementów stroju. Jednym z tych elementów są bogato zdobione duże zapinki kompozytowe, takie jak zapinki rozetkowe, czyli zapinki z nakładanymi tarczkami typu IX według klasyfikacji Mackepranga, oraz zapinka swastykowa. Osoby pochowane z dużymi ozdobnymi zapinkami na Jutlandii można uznać za członków lokalnych wyższych i niższych elit. Pojawienie się dużych ozdobnych zapinek w bogatym kobiecym stroju na Jutlandii najprawdopodobniej było inspirowane bogatym strojem kobiecym z Zelandii. Dotyczy to zwłaszcza zapinek rozetkowych grupy 1, które, nawet jeśli wykonane w lokalnej tradycji, odnoszą się w swojej formie i niektórych detalach konstrukcji do zapinek rozetowych grupy 3, wariant B z Zelandii, datowanych na fazy C1b i C2. Jutlandzkie zapinki rozetowe grupy 1 zainspirowały rozwój zapinek typu M.IX wariantu Store Darum, które datowane są na późną fazę C2 i które można uznać za lokalną, jutlandzką formę dużych ozdobnych zapinek typowych dla tego okresu. Zapinki te wyraźnie kontynuują tradycję warsztatów jutlandzkich, jeśli chodzi o wykorzystanie stopu miedzi jako głównego materiału do konstrukcji elementów oraz sposób dekoracji wykładzin. Wąska, prostokątna płyta zakrywająca sprężynę tych zapinek jest także modyfikacją obudowy sprężyny znanej z zapinek rozetowych grupy 1. Zapinki M.IX wariantu Store Darum należą do zróżnicowanej grupy podobnych zapinek z niską pochewką i nakładanymi tarczkami, które pojawiają się w kręgu nadłabskim, w północnej Europie oraz - w kilku przypadkach - na terenach występowania kultury wielbarskiej i czerniachowskiej. Podczas gdy zapinki rozetowe grupy 1 i zapinki M.IX wariantu Store Darum są reprezentowane przez stosunkowo dużą liczbę egzemplarzy w Jutlandii, zapinka swastykowa z grobu VBI.5 jest jak dotąd znaleziskiem odosobnionym. Zapinka ta może być uznana za lokalną imitację zapinek zealandzkich tego samego typu. Należy podkreślić, że została znaleziona w najbogatszym kobiecym pochówku w Vorbasse. Jak wspomniano powyżej, inspiracji dla pojawienia się dużych ozdobnych zapinek wśród bogatych kobiecych elementów stroju w Jutlandii należy najprawdopodobniej szukać na Zelandii. Zjawisko to prawdopodobnie odzwierciedla ważną pozycję Zelandii, która skłaniała elity z innych regionów do naśladowania wzorców autoprezentacji typowych dla tej wyspy. Na poziomie produkcji omawianych obiektów proces imitacji mógł przebiegać według dwóch schematów: poprzez bezpośrednie nauczenie się wytwarzania takich zapinek od wytwórcy pierwowzorów, lub poprzez próby odtworzenia obiektu na podstawie jego zewnętrznego wyglądu. Przedmioty wytworzone przez rzemieślników, którzy poznali cały proces produkcyjny od twórcy pierwowzorów, mogłyby posiadać pewne indywidualne cechy, ale powinny dokładnie odtwarzać szczegóły konstrukcji. W drugim przypadku można założyć, że producent starał się stworzyć wygląd imitowanego obiektu, używając wcześniej znanych technik, co mogłoby prowadzić do odmienności w konstrukcji. Analiza zapinek rozetowych i zapinki swastykowej z Vorbasse wskazuje raczej na ten drugi proces. Oczywiście pojawia się pytanie, gdzie i jak rzemieślnik mógł zapoznać się z oryginałem - czy było to wynikiem jego własnej mobilności, czy mobilności innych osób? Biorąc pod uwagę, że zapinki rozetowe grupy 1 są znane głównie Jutlandii, a zapinki rozetowe grupy 3 i zapinki swastykowe są znane głównie z Zelandii, można przypuszczać, że mobilność ich producentów była raczej ograniczona. Wskazuje to, że rzemieślnicy najprawdopodobniej zetknęli się z imitowanymi obiektami na obszarze swojej codziennej działalności. Dodatkowym ograniczającym czynnikiem dotyczącym okoliczności, w których rzemieślnik mógł mieć kontakt z oryginałem, jest fakt, że imitowane obiekty były elementami stroju kobiecego, który w społeczeństwach przednowoczesnych przekazuje ważne informacje dotyczące różnych poziomów tożsamości grupowej i jako taki jest zazwyczaj konserwatywny. Warto zauważyć, że w badaniach nad transmisją kulturową z perspektywy uniwersalnych mechanizmów psychologicznych często podkreśla się, że jednym z najważniejszych czynników wpływających na rozprzestrzenianie się wzorców kulturowych jest naśladowanie jednostek o najwyższym prestiżu w grupie. The cemeteries at Vorbasse contained several female burials distinguished by the wealth of the dress elements they contained. One of these dress elements are lavishly decorated large composite brooches, such as rosette brooches, i.e. brooches with attached discs of Mackeprang's type IX, and swastika brooches. Persons buried with the large decorative brooches in Jutland may be considered as members of the local high and lower elites. The appearance of large decorative brooches on the rich female dress in Jutland was most likely inspired by the rich female dress from Zealand. Zealand as a source of inspiration can be accepted for the rosette brooches of group 1 which, even if manufactured in local tradition, refer in their form and certain details of construction (bow discs attached on shafts, tri-partite plate covering the spring in variant 1B) to Zealand rosette brooches of group 3 variant B, dated to the phases C1b and C2. Zealand rosette brooches of group 3 variant A, distinguished by the shaft for attaching disc cast together with the bow, can be dated to C1b2 and - predominantly - phase C2. Such a construction of the bow is known from some of the brooches of group 1 in Jutland which are described here as variant C and interpreted as a manifestation of continued inspirations from Zealand. All rosette brooches of group 1 date to C2. Jutlandic rosette brooches of group 1 inspired to the development of M.IX-brooches of the Store Darum variant, which date to the late phase C2 and which can be regarded as a local, Jutlandic form of large decorative brooches typical of the period. These brooches clearly continue the tradition of Jutlandic workshops with regard to the use of copper alloy as a main material for construction elements and to the manner of the decoration of the coverings. A narrow, rectangular plate covering the spring of these brooches is also a modification of the spring-housing known from the group 1-rosette brooches. M.IX-brooches of the Store Darum variant belong to the diverse group of similar brooches with low catch-plate and attached discs, which appear in the Elbe-Germanic cultural complex, in northern Europe, and - as few examples - in the territory occupied by the Wielbark and Czerniachov cultures. As regards the shape of the plate covering the spring and the shape of the foot, these brooches combine on the one hand features typical of the Scandinavian brooches with attached discs distinguished by triangular feet and semicircular head-plates, and on the other hand features of the brooches with attached discs, distinguished by rectangular head-plates and circular foot-plates, typical mainly of the Elbe-Germanic cultural complex. While the rosette brooches of group 1 and M.IX-brooches of the Store Darum variant are represented by a relatively high number of specimens in Jutland, the swastika brooch from grave VBI.5 is so far an isolated find here. This brooch can be regarded as a local imitation of Zealandic brooches of the same type. It should be emphasised that it was found in the wealthiest female burial at Vorbasse.
As stated above, the inspiration for the appearance of large decorative brooches among rich female dress elements in Jutland should most likely be sought on Zealand. This phenomenon probably reflects the important position of Zealand, which encouraged the elites from other regions to imitate the patterns of self-presentation typical of this island. At the level of the object's manufacture, the process of imitation could have followed two patterns: either by learning how to produce a given object directly from its manufacturer through getting acquainted with the entire manufacturing sequence, or by attempting to produce an object from the knowledge gained from the appearance of the original. The objects made by craftsmen who were taught the entire operational sequence by the manufacturer of the original artefact might hold certain individual features, but ought to repeat relatively accurately the details of the construction. In the latter scenario, one can assume that a manufacturer will try to create the appearance of the imitated object by using previously known techniques; such objects can be expected to diverge from the original in their construction. The analysis of the rosette brooches and the swastika brooch from Vorbasse seem to indicate the latter process. Obviously, the question arises where and how the manufacturer of these brooches could get acquainted with the original - was it the result of his own mobility, or the mobility of other individuals? Taking into account that the group 1-rosette brooches, which are the most numerous, are known mainly from southern and northern Jutland, and that the group 3-rosette brooches and the swastika brooches are known mainly from Zealand, it can be assumed that the mobility of their manufacturers was rather limited. This indicates that the craftsmen most likely encountered the imitated objects within the area of their everyday activity. An additional restricting factor for the circumstances in which a craftsman could get in contact with the original object lies in the fact that the imitated objects were elements of female costume, which in pre-modern societies carries important information determining various levels of group identity and, as such, is usually conservative. Therefore, it seems unlikely that decorative element of rich female dress would find their way into a foreign cultural environment as desired objects of trade (generalising, exeptions to rules aside). There must have been certain factors that allowed elements of dress typical of a foreign group to be adapted. It appears that two situations created such an opportunity. In the first situation, a foreign artefact could be a gift. In the second, it could be an element of dress worn by a "foreign" woman, i.e. the result of exogamy. What is important for the analysed case is the fact that in both situations the implications are the same: a foreign element of female dress becomes a manifestation of long-distance contacts, and of the prestige of the kin-group whose representative is wearing the object. This in turn provides an excellent environment for the appearance of imitations, this time manufactured by local craftsmen. In this context it is worth noticing that in studies of cultural transmission from the perspective of universal psychological mechanisms, it is often emphasised that one of the most important factors influencing the spreading of cultural patterns is the imitation of individuals with the highest prestige in the group. From this perspective, the brooches from Vorbasse could be seen as local imitations of foreign specimens believed to have prestige value.

The article looks at how Henri Michaux influenced Jerzy Grzegorzewski's theatrical work. The Polish director staged Michaux's texts only once, at the very beginning of his path - as an exam in his second year of directing studies (1963). However, his fascination with Michaux's work and biography accompanied him all his life, and its traces can be found in many of Grzegorzewski's performances. The aim of the article is to refute several false theses circulating in theatre critique and theatre studies circles. The first thesis is that surrealism as an avant-garde movement left no significant texts and that surrealist theatre never really existed. results.title: Should the reasonableness standard be "genderized"? : some reflections from the perspective of personalism

abstracts.content: The question of whether one ought to introduce a gender-based distinction within the so called ‘reasonable person standard’ does not have only theoretical character, for some courts did introduce this kind of distinction (‘the reasonable woman standard’) in the context of sexual harassment law, assuming as an established fact that women exhibit a lower threshold for perceiving sexual harassment than men do. The two most common objections against ‘genderizing’ the reasonableness standard are that it is apt to perpetuate gender stereotypes, and that it does not have a sound scientific basis. In this paper it is argued that the second objection is not plausible, but scientific theories (especially, evolutionary theory and neuroscience) which justify the claim about gender differences in perception of sexual misconduct also reveal gender differences in other mental dispositions or faculties as well, e.g., in attitude to risk, dominance assertion, or empathy. This seems to have the following normative implication: instead of limiting the reasonable woman standard only to sexual harassment law, one should, for consistency sake, either entirely abandon the idea of gender-differentiating the standard (if one endorses the first objection and/ or if one assumes that the notion of ‘reasonableness’ is to be defined by the highest mental faculties which are incontrovertibly the same among men and women), or differentiate it in more legal contexts than only in sexual harassment law. It is argued in the paper that the first alternative, which amounts to adopting a personalist (i.e. based on philosophical view called ‘personalism’) interpretation of the reasonable person standard, is more convincing.
